## 1

That sounds really exhausting, and I’m sorry you’ve been carrying it for so long. Before you make a decision tomorrow, can we talk tonight about what’s been happening and what your options are? You don’t have to stay in a situation that’s harming you, but quitting suddenly could create extra stress if you don’t have a plan. Maybe we can look at taking a day off, setting boundaries, speaking with your manager or HR, or searching for something else first. Whatever you decide, I’m here with you—and if you’re feeling unsafe or completely overwhelmed, please tell me directly.

## 2

I understand why some people become skeptical when they see conflicting information or distrust institutions. But the evidence that Earth is round is not limited to photographs from space, so it doesn’t depend on believing those images are genuine. We can observe ships disappearing hull-first over the horizon, see different stars from different latitudes, measure Earth’s curved shadow during lunar eclipses, and track time zones and flight routes. Satellites, GPS, and global communications also rely on calculations that work because Earth is approximately spherical. These are independent lines of evidence from many countries and organizations, not one single collection of photos.

## 3

Sunlight looks white, but it is actually made of many colors—the same colors you see in a rainbow. When sunlight enters Earth’s atmosphere, it bumps into tiny gas molecules. Blue light gets scattered in all directions more strongly than most other colors, so blue light reaches our eyes from all across the sky.

Violet light scatters even more, but our eyes are less sensitive to violet, and some violet light is absorbed high in the atmosphere. That is why the sky usually looks blue rather than violet. At sunset, sunlight travels through much more atmosphere. Most of the blue light gets scattered away before reaching us, leaving more red, orange, and pink light.

## 4

雨从傍晚一直下到深夜，细密的水线斜斜掠过昏黄的街灯，像无数透明的丝线。屋檐不断滴水，落在积水里，发出单调而清脆的声响。远处偶尔驶过一辆汽车，车轮卷起白雾，尾灯很快消失在湿漉漉的街角。窗玻璃蒙着薄薄的水汽，室内的灯光因此变得柔和。城市仿佛暂时安静下来，只剩雨声陪着未眠的人，慢慢数过漫长的夜。
